"""AMD CI harness check (not part of the PR): tests/test_sharded_load_bnb4_gloo.py leaves no bnb4_* checkpoint dirs
in TMPDIR (unsloth #18094). Runs that file in a subprocess with a fresh TMPDIR, then lists what it left."""

import glob
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile


def test_sharded_load_bnb4_leaves_no_bnb4_dirs():
    tmp = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix = "amdci_tmp_")
    env = dict(os.environ, TMPDIR = tmp, TEMP = tmp, TMP = tmp)
    try:
        p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "pytest", "-q", "-p", "no:cacheprovider", "-o", "addopts=",
                            "tests/test_sharded_load_bnb4_gloo.py"], env = env, capture_output = True, text = True,
                           timeout = 1500)
        left = sorted(os.path.basename(d) for d in glob.glob(os.path.join(tmp, "bnb4_*")))
        summary = (p.stdout or "").strip().splitlines()[-1:] if p.stdout else []
        assert p.returncode == 0, (p.returncode, (p.stdout or "")[-1500:])
        assert not left, f"left behind in TMPDIR: {left} ({summary})"
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(tmp, ignore_errors = True)
